description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit field-to-lot traceability records with the planting and harvest records they answer to: each planting record with its id, reference, field and crop; each harvest record with its id, reference, the harvest lot code, field, crop and the moment harvested; each lot in the traceability record with its id, lot code, the field of origin it records, crop, whether it is recorded as blended and the source fields a blend lists; each shipment with its id, reference, the lot code shipped, the buyer and the moment shipped. The signed report gives the lots and the shipments, each lot’s recorded field of origin against the harvest records for the lot and the planting records for the field, each shipment against a harvest lot behind it, and each blended lot against the source fields the harvest and planting records hold, and counts them, and names divergent traceability records: a harvest lot whose recorded field of origin does not match the planting and harvest records, a shipment recorded with no harvest lot behind it, and a lot recorded as blended whose source fields the records do not list; then a lot recorded with no field of origin and a harvest naming a lot the traceability record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No lots and no shipments, or lots with fields of origin and no harvest or planting records beside them, leaves those points unverified. Fields, lots and shipments match by letters and digits, a lot’s field of origin is read against every harvest record naming the lot and the planting records for that field and crop, a shipment needs a lot the lot record or the harvest records hold, and a blended lot’s source fields are read against the harvest and planting records. This reads origin traceability in the farm’s own records: wever_food-recall-check reads food recall and lot traceability records downstream, in the food business’s file, while the traceability check reads whether every lot leaving the farm traces back to the field it was grown on. Verdict agri_traceability_divergent, agri_traceability_partial, agri_traceability_unverified or agri_traceability_consistent. POST /api/agri-traceability-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
